Condensed source passage, selected from the supplied excerpt; other details are omitted: When meteor showers occur every few months, viewers get to watch a dazzling scene of shooting stars and light streaks scattering across the night sky. To help the team train and speed up the AI and machine learning algorithms they’re developing to detect threats that are on a collision course with Earth, NVIDIA, as part of its Applied Research Accelerator Program , has given the group an NVIDIA RTX A6000 graphics card. On average, about every 60 years, an asteroid that’s larger than 65 feet in diameter will appear, similar to the one that exploded over Chelyabinsk, Russia, in 2013 , with the energy equivalent of about 440,000 tons of TNT, according to NASA. The PI-Terminal Planetary Defense initiative aims to detect relevant threats sooner, and then use an array of hypervelocity kinetic penetrators to pulverize and disassemble an asteroid or small comet to greatly minimize the threat. “Each image will be about 100 megapixels, and we’re putting many images inside the memory of the RTX GPU,” said Lubin.
